new_results.statement: For an orthonormal dependent two-dimensional original-product projection P, an independent normalized scalar product projection V, invertible symmetric B, gamma!=0, row-span affine term and arbitrary measurable same-bank shift h, Q=P^T B P+ell^T P+c+gamma(V+h)^2 has ||p_Q||inf <=16 sqrt(60)|gamma|^(-1/2)|det B|^(-1/4).
For an invertible 3x3 core Gamma=[[C,b],[b^T,gamma]] with gamma!=0 on (P,V), ||p_Q||inf <=16 sqrt(60)(|gamma det Gamma|)^(-1/4).

For the latest account02/B16 bank-aggregated fresh-square family with 4|m, m>=16 and eta>0, the supplied essential bound 4 and the newest volume-stability theorem combine to give a continuous density vanishing at infinity with pointwise sup <=4.

For any independent extra random block W, the latest account02/B16 family satisfies ||p_(Q+W)||inf<=4; for m>=16 its density is continuous with the same bound. In particular W may be any independent quadratic form of arbitrary dimension and signature.
